lines: One recon drone and one cruise missile! We've got multiple targets incoming!
Look at the radar! You can switch between targets using the RADAR DIAL.
The missile is much faster than the drone. We need to deal with it FIRST!
Quick, turn the radar dial and select the cruise missile!
Good work! Remember, you can remove your current wave with the MINUS button and add a fresh one with the PLUS button.
Don't waste time trying to fix a wave that's completely wrong. Sometimes it's faster to start over!
Did you see how quickly that missile approached?
Different threats have different speeds. Always keep an eye on your radar!
Prioritize the most dangerous incoming contacts before it's too late.
